summary: Tested Orange Pharmacy PDF import (1246 items, 28 categories), text-only card design, and doctor-leave bug fix (/api/doctors/blocked-dates + next-available fix). 12/13 backend tests passed (92% success). Frontend /pharmacy loads with 1,246+ medicines banner, text-only cards, DROTIN search works, ProductDetailView shows the 'Price shown is after 15–20% discount' note with data-testid=price-after-discount-note. One real data-import bug found: DROZIVER pack-size collapse left 2 entries instead of 1.

minor.issue: Pack-size collapse incomplete: returns TWO entries ['DROZIVER 80MG', 'DROZIVER 80 6TAB'] instead of ONE collapsed entry per task rule. import_orange_pdf_inventory.py collapse rule failed for this variant group. Other collapse (ORTHAL FORTE) and typo merges (VEET REMOVEL, TETAN 20/40) worked correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: Search-result list row for DROTIN still shows an 'MRP ₹199' strike-through above the current price. Per task rules the new PDF items have no separate MRP/discount — price is shown as-is with only the discount note. The strike-through creates a fake discount visual.

For items with no image_url, ProductDetailView still renders a large 'No image available' placeholder box. The pharmacy redesign was TEXT-ONLY (no images/icons) for these items — the placeholder should be hidden and header should collapse. Cream card design was applied on the browse grid but not inside ProductDetailView.

issues: Header text reads '1,246+ medicines delivered to your doorstep' but task spec said '1,246 products across 28 categories' should be visible. The category count is not exposed in the hero text.

action_items: Fix DROZIVER pack-collapse in import_orange_pdf_inventory.py — currently 'DROZIVER 80MG' and 'DROZIVER 80 6TAB' both remain; only one collapsed entry expected. Total is 1246 today, so if collapse is re-run the total may drop by 1.

Remove the 'MRP ₹xxx' strike-through in the medicine search-result row when discount_percent === 0 (new PDF dataset). Currently DROTIN row shows '₹189  MRP ₹199' which fakes a discount that the backend does not have.
In ProductDetailView, hide the 'No image available' placeholder box when image_url is empty, to match the text-only card design intent used elsewhere.
Consider exposing 'across 28 categories' in the /pharmacy header per task spec.
critical_code_review_comments: pharmacy_browse.py has a 5-min in-memory cache with no invalidation hook — after any medicines-collection update (like re-import), stale results will be served for up to 5 minutes. Add a POST /pharmacy/v3/cache/flush or subscribe to a change stream.

appointment_routes.get_doctor_schedule_by_name() does a $or lookup on staff.doctor_name/name and returns the FIRST doctor_schedule found — if two staff records match the same display name across clinics, wrong schedule could be returned. Consider disambiguating by clinic when available.

/api/doctors/next-available hardcodes sessions = [11:00-14:00, 18:00-22:00] and slot_duration=15 regardless of the doctor's actual doctor_schedules.weekly_schedule/slot_duration — fix ignores the doctor's real working hours.

rca_of_issues.DROZIVER duplicate: import_orange_pdf_inventory.py's pack-size-collapse rule likely groups by name ending pattern like '<base> <strength> <N>TAB' but 'DROZIVER 80MG' does not match the '<N>TAB' pattern and slipped through, leaving both the MG variant and the 6TAB variant. The 14 declared pack-size groups probably need this specific variant added.
rca_of_issues.MRP strike-through: MedicineCard.jsx list-row variant still renders mrp field as strike-through even when discount_percent === 0 and mrp differs from price by only a few rupees. The new dataset writes mrp=price into the same row; frontend should check discount_percent > 0 (or (mrp - price) > threshold) before showing MRP strike-through.
